name: SAM
description: Sharpness-Aware Minimization optimizer using a two-pass closure-based update.

parameters.backend_options: local SAM options: rho and adaptive

examples.title: Minimize a quadratic with SAM
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.sam import sam

parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(3.0))
optimizer = sam([parameter], lr=0.05)
def closure():
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = (parameter - 1).square()
    loss.backward()
    return loss
for _ in range(20):
    optimizer.step(closure)
